verdict.rationale: Extend's own docs cover all three parts of the story: zero data retention options configurable at the workspace level (including with AI subprocessors), SOC 2 Type II controls with reports in a Trust Center, and a HIPAA Compliance and BAA add-on. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of ZDR and compliance handling, explicit SOC 2 certification wording (the docs say 'controls aligned with' SOC 2 Type II), and clarity on which tiers include ZDR and HIPAA, which appear to be add-ons.

support.subject: As a data engineer, uploaded documents get zero-retention handling with SOC 2 and HIPAA options, so I can process contracts and medical records

citations.quote: We also support zero data retention options.
